title: British Tennis Star Emma Raducanu Withdraws from Wimbledon Due to Leg Injury
summary: Emma Raducanu, the 23-year-old former U.S. Open champion, has withdrawn from her first-round match at Wimbledon due to a leg injury. The decision was announced on the eve of her match. This is a setback for Raducanu, who had been looking forward to competing in her first Grand Slam tournament since winning the U.S. Open last year.
summary_points: Emma Raducanu has withdrawn from Wimbledon due to a leg injury.
The decision was announced on the eve of her first-round match.
Raducanu is a former U.S. Open champion.
This is a setback for Raducanu, who had been looking forward to competing in her first Grand Slam tournament since winning the U.S. Open last year.
The withdrawal may impact Raducanu's chances of performing well at Wimbledon.
